china-1928:p0107_1.rationale: Annual coal production capacity by nationality and type of capital (foreign, Sino-foreign, Chinese). The subject is coal mining capacity. The ownership breakdown is not a foreign-privilege subject, so no imperialism topic is added.

china-1928:p0107_2.rationale: Coke output by coal field, with coking process and where it is consumed. Coke is covered by the coal tag.

china-1928:p0108_1.rationale: Distribution of Fushun coal by destination, covering domestic regions, Japan, overseas and steamship bunkers. This is coal distribution and trade.

china-1928:p0108_2.rationale: Kailan coal exported from Chinwangtao and distributed by railway line, destination and use. This is coal distribution and export.

china-1928:p0108_3.rationale: Coal consumption in four cities with population and per-capita rate. The subject is coal consumption. Population is only a denominator.

china-1928:p0108_4.rationale: Customs figures for imports and exports of coal and coke, 1921-1925.

china-1928:p0109_1.rationale: Estimated percentage shares of coal use by sector: domestic, industrial, communication and export.
review_questions: Is a coal-consumption tag needed? None exists in the vocabulary, so coal is used.

china-1928:p0109_2.rationale: Iron ore deposits by type, with ore tonnage, iron content and average grade. These are reserve estimates.

china-1928:p0110_1.rationale: Annual iron ore output 1920-1925 by province, locality, company and capital type.

china-1928:p0112_1.rationale: Imports, exports and estimated consumption of iron ore and of iron and steel, 1920-1925.
